title: A 1:40 scale model of the Red Pyramid exploded under pressure

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. And I'm sure you saw that we made a 1 to 40 scale model of the red pyramid and it completely exploded due to the pressure on the inside of this thing.

plain: A model of the Red Pyramid, one of Egypt's ancient pyramids, built at one-fortieth its real size, "completely exploded due to the pressure on the inside," according to Geoffrey Drumm, who says he and his team built it. Drumm tells Michels this on an episode where he says an alien showed him what the pyramids were really for, and he offers the blast as a sign that the real pyramid was built to hold great pressure inside, like a machine.
